answer: Let each attestation define a weighted edge, and propagate trust through random walks capped at a fixed number of steps; this limits how far influence can spread. If sybils form a cluster with few links to honest nodes, its external cut has low conductance, so few walks enter it and its aggregate voting weight is bounded by cut capacity and the walk budget. Even nodes named oasis, whisper, and juniper gain no extra weight merely by attesting to one another.
